local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:Titlebox/theme')
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame, {
		wrappers = 'Template:Titlebox'
	})
	return p._main(args)
end
function p._main(args)
    local key = args.name
    local thema = data[key] or {}

    -- Template args will override data 
    local bg = args.bg or thema.bg or '#000'
    local color = args.color or thema.color or '#fff'
    local txtshd = args.txtshd or thema.txtshd or ''
    local pos = args.pos or thema.pos or 'relative'
    local ovfl = args.ovfl or thema.ovfl or ''
    local padding = args.padding or '2px 5px'

    local title = args.customtext or thema.customtext or args.title or key or ''
    local link = args.link or key or ''

    local root = mw.html.create('')
    local box = root:tag('div')
        :css{
            width='auto',
            padding=padding,
            background=bg,
            position=pos,
            overflow=ovfl
        }

    if link == 'no' then
        box:wikitext('<span style="color:'..color..'; text-shadow:'..txtshd..'; font-weight:bold;">'..title..'</span>')
    else
        box:wikitext('[['..link..'|<span style="color:'..color..'; text-shadow:'..txtshd..'; font-weight:bold;">'..title..'</span>]]')
    end

    return root
end
return p
